svg.title: SLM-Tavenel 1M, 10M and grown 25M benchmark comparison
svg.desc: Six panels compare raw accuracy from the repository evaluator for SLM-Tavenel and public SLM references on identical pinned benchmark files. Error bars are one standard error across questions, conditional on each checkpoint; they do not represent training-seed variability. Pythia-31M has results only for ARC-Challenge and WinoGrande.
svg.text: SLM-Tavenel scaling and SLM reference benchmarks
Same local evaluator and pinned item files · bars: raw accuracy · whiskers: ±1 item standard error
Chance: 25% on four-choice tasks; 50% on binary WinoGrande. Different training data, tokenizers, budgets and known exposure limit cross-model interpretation.
